Figures of this listing, as shown on its product page: Coriolis-tube mass flowmeter providing simultaneous mass flow, fluid density, and fluid temperature outputs. Used as a non-radioactive densitometer (NRD) for cementing units, hydration units, and Liquid Additive Systems where radioactive source devices are restricted.
2-inch process connections as standard; 1-inch and 3-inch available. Local digital display + 4-20 mA remote outputs. ATEX Zone 1 / 2 enclosure variants.

ATEX Zone 1 is an area where an explosive gas atmosphere is likely to occur occasionally in normal operation; Zone 2 is an area where it is not likely in normal operation and, if it occurs, lasts only for a short time. Ex-d denotes flameproof enclosure protection.
extraFacts.source: ATEX workplace Directive 1999/92/EC annex I; IEC 60079-0 / 60079-1 (flameproof enclosure 'd')

extraFacts.fact: A 4-20 mA signal is a standard analogue current loop in which 4 mA is the bottom of the range and 20 mA the top, so a broken wire can be told from a zero reading.
extraFacts.source: IEC 60381-1 (analogue signals for process control, 4 to 20 mA)

faqs.q: What is a 2-inch Coriolis mass flowmeter (NRD) used for?
faqs.a: It is a Coriolis-tube mass flowmeter giving mass flow, fluid density and fluid temperature at once, used as a non-radioactive densitometer (NRD) on cementing units, hydration units and Liquid Additive Systems. See the [Coriolis NRD shelf](/c/ic-coriolis-nrd).

faqs.q: What does NRD stand for on this Coriolis flowmeter?
faqs.a: NRD means non-radioactive densitometer: the meter measures density with a Coriolis tube instead of a radioactive source. This suits units where radioactive source devices are restricted.

faqs.q: What sizes does the Coriolis NRD flowmeter come in?
faqs.a: 2-inch process connections are standard, and 1-inch and 3-inch are available. State your line size when you ask. Share the duty and any standard that applies and we will confirm the match.

faqs.q: What outputs does the Coriolis NRD flowmeter give?
faqs.a: It gives mass flow, fluid density and fluid temperature, with a local digital display and 4-20 mA remote outputs. The 4-20 mA lets you feed a data acquisition system.

faqs.q: Which service is the Coriolis NRD flowmeter built for?
faqs.a: The listing names cementing service, with local and remote display. It is also used on hydration units and Liquid Additive Systems. If you are unsure, send us the requirement and we will confirm.

faqs.q: Is the Coriolis NRD flowmeter available for hazardous areas?
faqs.a: The listing says ATEX Zone 1 / 2 enclosure variants are available. Tell us the zone and we confirm the variant. Tell us the application and we check it against the specification.

faqs.q: How does the Coriolis NRD flowmeter connect to a data system?
faqs.a: Through its 4-20 mA remote outputs, which feed a [data acquisition system](/c/ic-data-acquisition). The local digital display shows values at the meter. Send us the details and we confirm the specification before supply.

faqs.q: Why use a Coriolis meter rather than a turbine meter?
faqs.a: A Coriolis meter measures mass flow, density and temperature together, while a [turbine flowmeter](/p/turbine-flowmeter-2-inch-fig-1502-f-m-15-000-psi-frac-cementing-service) measures volume flow only. Choose Coriolis where density matters, as in cementing.

faqs.q: What do I need to tell Indus to quote the the 2-inch Coriolis mass flowmeter (NRD)?
faqs.a: Quote the full title, Coriolis Mass Flowmeter (NRD), 2-inch, Cementing Service, Local + Remote Display, with the variant, size or voltage you need, and say where it will be used and which standard or zone applies. We confirm the specification and lead time on the quotation; start on [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: Where is the Coriolis NRD flowmeter used?
faqs.a: It is used on cementing units, hydration units and Liquid Additive Systems where radioactive source devices are restricted. The [oilfield instrumentation guide](/blog/oilfield-pressure-and-flow-instrumentation) covers where it fits.

faqs.q: Where is the Coriolis NRD flowmeter supplied from?
faqs.a: We supply it from Dubai, UAE and ship worldwide. Send the line size and the zone for the enclosure. Send us the details and we confirm the specification before supply.

faqs.q: Is the 2-inch Coriolis mass flowmeter (NRD) in stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We keep the 2-inch Coriolis mass flowmeter (NRD) in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the part numbers and quantities through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.
